groups.roleLegend: What each role can do here:
groups.roleCan.admin: Everything: bills, entries, roles, the books, and closing the group.
groups.roleCan.treasurer: Adds bills, settles up, posts journal entries and runs the reconciliation. Cannot change roles or delete the group.
groups.roleCan.auditor: Reads everything and can raise a flag on a bill or a journal entry. Changes nothing.
groups.roleCan.member: Sees the group, its bills and its history. Adds nothing.
groups.roleNoManage: Only the group owner can change roles. Ask them if you need more.
groups.roleNeedsAccount: They have not signed up yet. A role fills in the moment they register — give it to them then.
